CustomField.description: Nullable: blank = logged in a standalone (cycle-less) session, visible only in that session's workspace. Cycled findings form the team log: anyone in the cycle audience reads them; edit/delete is author-or-UAT_Console-admin, enforced in Apex. Restricted delete: UatCycleAdminController.deleteCycle purges a cycle's findings explicitly.
CustomField.label: Test Cycle
